evidence.reason: judge current anchor failed verification: At the pinned tip the existing-worktree scan still probes every in-root candidate carrying the review label with `git -C <candidate.path> rev-parse HEAD` and then `rev-list --count <expected>..HEAD` on that same path. For a registered worktree whose directory was deleted, `git worktree list --porcelain` still emits the entry, rev-parse fails so `atSha` is false, and the subsequent rev-list also fails because `-C` points at the missing directory. The code then throws the "relation ... unknown" error, wedging every retry until manual `git worktree prune`. The visible scan has no prunable/missing-directory skip or prune, so this is an implementation defect in the intended stale-worktree convergence behavior.
